author: Revalioli
quote: After playing both GTA6 as well as Zelda Ocarina of time, i can clearly tell the difference in passion and in corprate greed. Gta6 is highly flawed and makes the user feel like we have unrealistic standards for gaming in 2026. Although the game looks good, It runs at a headache inducing 30 FPS. The game is also litered with bugs of all kinds. (which is normal in a new release but not in a game thats been over 13 years since the last installment.) The game lacks autosaves, and stops you from commiting thieft on automobiles until later in the game. This feels less like a gta game than ever. I would still buy another Red Dead Redemption but i would never buy another GTA game after this massive failure. I really dont want to be a dodding boyfriend, i would way rather run around and do criminal activites in game, I dont know how this game got 8 Nominations at the gameawards. Still holding out hope i can get with Mandy and drop Lucia. I can without a doubt say that this game does not deserve to be at a 99 Metacritic score and that Ocarina of Time Remake should be. I dont understand the way the industry is moving and i really wish i could return my copy of GTA6 asap.
